D/ SEVERVS......PIVS AVG PIVS ; R/ FVNDAT[OR] [PA]CIS

OBVERSE DESCRIPTION: Head of Septimius Severus facing right with typically spiky beard and wearing laureate. Circle of pellets around the circumference. F type obverse. OBVERSE INSCRIPTION: SEVERVS......PIVS AVG PIVS: meaning 'Dutiful' and AVG: meaning 'Holy' - a title assumed by the first emperor, which is subsequently taken by all his successors. The coin has a high relief. REVERSE DESCRIPTION: Severus standing facing left holding an olive-branch. Wearing a robe with head dress. Circle of pellets around the circumference. REVERSE INSCRIPTION: FVNDAT[OR] [PA]CIS
